# 01_PRE_CUTOVER_READONLY_PREFLIGHT.sh
# Read-only enumeration of EVERY root-equivalent / re-grant source for AGENT_USER
# (default k3). Safe to run repeatedly; performs NO mutation. Fixes review
# U24/U15/S01-S13/FR1/AX5 + section 13.
#
# Fail-closed: any OPEN vector OR any INDETERMINATE probe -> exit 3. A non-root
# run cannot read privileged sources, so it reports INDETERMINATE and exits 3
# (never a false PREFLIGHT=CLEAN). --strict additionally escalates advisories.
# shellcheck shell=bash
set -uo pipefail
SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
# shellcheck source=lib/common.sh
. "$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/common.sh" || { echo "FATAL: cannot source lib/common.sh (fail-closed)" >&2; exit 1; }

STRICT=0
for a in "$@"; do [ "$a" = "--strict" ] && STRICT=1; done
IS_ROOT=0; [ "$(id -u)" = "0" ] && IS_ROOT=1
OPEN=0
note_open() { OPEN=$((OPEN+1)); printf '  [OPEN] %s\n' "$*"; }
note_indet(){ OPEN=$((OPEN+1)); printf '  [INDETERMINATE] %s\n' "$*"; }   # fail-closed
note_ok()   { printf '  [OK] %s\n' "$*"; }
note_info() { printf '  [INFO] %s\n' "$*"; }
# advisory: [WARN] normally, but escalates to OPEN (fail-closed) under --strict.
note_warn() { if [ "$STRICT" = 1 ]; then OPEN=$((OPEN+1)); printf '  [OPEN:strict] %s\n' "$*"; else printf '  [WARN] %s\n' "$*"; fi; }
REBOOT_REQUIRED=NO
set_reboot() { REBOOT_REQUIRED=YES; }

log "=== P5 PRE-CUTOVER READ-ONLY PREFLIGHT (AGENT_USER=$AGENT_USER, root=$IS_ROOT, strict=$STRICT) ==="
assert_agent_user_resolves
[ "$IS_ROOT" = 1 ] || note_indet "preflight NOT run as root: sudoers, root/admin authorized_keys, and some sources are unreadable; a CLEAN verdict requires root"

echo "== identity & groups =="
id "$AGENT_USER" 2>&1 | sed 's/^/  /'
# F7-16(a): a failing `id -nG` must NOT silently yield an empty set (false-CLEAN);
# capture explicitly and mark INDETERMINATE (blocks CLEAN) on failure.
if ! AGENT_GROUPS="$(id -nG "$AGENT_USER" 2>/dev/null)"; then
  note_indet "id -nG $AGENT_USER failed тА?cannot enumerate agent groups (fail-closed; blocks CLEAN)"
